script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The verse describes Amaziah's conduct without saying he started out that way.
The ‘wrong recipe’ comparison suggests Joash's example was wholly wrong, though the verse says Amaziah did what was right as Joash had done.
‘Day after day’ adds a frequency the text does not give.
The text does not say executing the servants was Amaziah's first piece of business.
The command concerns being put to death, not punishment in general.
The command concerns being put to death, not punishment in general.
The joke compares the striking down of 10,000 people to a large batch of cookies, making light of a violent event.
‘The thistle never stood a chance’ adds a claim the story does not make.
‘The thistle didn't last long’ adds a timeframe the story does not give.
Pride is not the opposite of fear; a person can be both proud and afraid.
The passage does not establish that nobody in the story is tired.
Staying put is not all Jehoash tells Amaziah to do; he also tells him to glory in his victory.
‘Nobody sat down to talk it over’ adds a detail the text does not give.
The fifteen years are counted from Jehoash's death, not from Amaziah's capture in battle.
The text says Jehoash took the specified valuables and articles, not that both places were entirely emptied.
The gates do come up in the passage: verse 13 names the Ephraim Gate and the Corner Gate.
The statement that Samaria was Israel's capital is a fact from outside the passage and needs its own reference.
‘That's the whole fact’ is a flat closing that adds nothing to the explanation.
The men sent after Amaziah and his death are described in the same verse, not the next one.
The joke places Papa Dorin in the drawer at a particular age, although he does not have an age.
‘Wrong kingdom’ uses ‘wrong’ in response to the baker's answer.
